channel.title: Federal Audiobooks: Air Force Leadership and Strategy
channel.description: Public-domain audiobooks from U.S. Air Force publications, chapter by chapter: command and leadership, speaking and listening, and strategy. item.title: Sharing Success-Owning Failure, Chapter 1: Preparing to Command in the Twenty-First Century Air Force
item.description: Chapter 1 of 6 of Sharing Success-Owning Failure: Preparing to Command in the Twenty-First Century Air Force, by Col David L. Goldfein (Air University Press, 2001). Then-Colonel Goldfein discusses themes central to a successful squadron command tour, using stories of success and failure to help officers prepare for command. Source: Air University Press audiobook, Air University Public Affairs, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/audio/50690 . Marked public domain on DVIDS; the audio is unaltered. Published by Liber Copia LLC, not by the U.S. Air Force. The appearance of U.S. Department of War (DoW) visual information does not imply or constitute DoW endorsement.
